class.name: OcgGCMakearcofcircle2d
class.brief_description: This class implements construction algorithms for arcs of circles in the plane. The result is a `Geom2d_TrimmedCurve`. A `GC_MakeArcOfCircle2d` object provides a framework for: - defining the construction parameters; - running the construction algorithm; - querying the construction status and the resulting arc via `Value()`.
class.description: ! This class implements construction algorithms for arcs of circles in the plane. ! The result is a `Geom2d_TrimmedCurve`. ! A `GC_MakeArcOfCircle2d` object provides a framework for: ! - defining the construction parameters; ! - running the construction algorithm; ! - querying the construction status and the resulting arc via `Value()`. ! @note Angular parameters are expressed in radians.

method.name: from_1
method.description: Constructs an arc passing through three points.

method.name: from_2
method.description: Constructs an arc from two points and tangent vector at start point.

method.name: from_3
method.description: Constructs an arc from angular bounds on a circle.

method.name: from_4
method.description: Constructs an arc from a point and angular bound on a circle.

method.name: from_5
method.description: Constructs an arc between two points on a circle.
